assessment.security_status_cs: Japonský jen těží z pozice bezpečného přístavu po globálním poklesu technologických akcií vyvolaném čínským modelem DeepSeek. assessment.security_status_en: The Japanese yen is benefiting from its safe-haven status following a global tech stock sell-off triggered by China's DeepSeek model. Meanwhile, Prime Minister Takaichi is strengthening regional cooperation with ASEAN on energy and supply chains, while the government considers tightening property flipping taxes to curb speculative transactions in overheated Tokyo.
